name: Nurujiru Tsuu
source:
During break time, during class, after school... this girl always answers protagonist's call and comforts him in any suit that he desires to see.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
无论课间休息、正在上课，还是放学以后……这名少女总会回应主人公的呼唤，穿上他想看的任何服装，用身体慰藉他。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
